property_summary: In the reference C, multiplicate is a pure no-op whenever msg.value is strictly less than the contract's balance, so it cannot make an external transfer to a reverting recipient and the call always succeeds; the mutant transfers whenever msg.value>0, so the transfer to a reverting recipient makes the call revert.
change_summary: Change the if condition to `msg.value > 0`, so transfers also happen when the previously required balance threshold is not met.
